title: Infinite burn
description: In this data-packet you will burn infinitely
body:
**Inside this packet, flames will spawn infinitely under your feet, so you will have to run. To make it easier, we've added a simpler barrel recipe that only requires three iron grains to craft a barrel; You can get anti-fire potions in the Nether portal ruins treasure chests, and killing piglins will also drop anti-fire potions, making you safer in the Nether. Standing on the edge of the block will not ignite**
